key_points: Q1 earnings beat and dividend hike by 17% provided fundamental support.
Stock still fell due to profit quality concerns and AI storage demand worries.
Seeking Alpha highlighted worsening cracks in the AI supercycle and issued a rating downgrade.
Analyst commentary linked the pullback to AI capex concerns and broader chip sell-off.
The rebound in memory/storage stocks appears fragile amid ongoing AI spending uncertainty.
